name: Ruby K. Bolton
tagline: Top rated Family Law attorney in The Woodlands, Texas
education: The University of Texas School of Law
about: Attorney Ruby K. Bolton is a board-certified family law specialist by the Texas Board of Legal Specialization. She runs Bolton Law Firm, P.C., in Spring, Texas. With an impressive breadth of knowledge in family law as well as estate planning and probate, she excels in managing high net worth divorce cases, business valuations, contested child custody issues, jury trials and complex paternity matters. Her three decades of experience have seen her guide numerous clients through challenging times, helping them safeguard their children and financial interests amidst divorce proceedings.

Ms. Bolton is well-known for achieving noteworthy outcomes and is dedicated to serving her clients in the Spring and Houston areas with top-tier legal representation. Her academic journey began with a Bachelor of Arts degree in English from Brigham Young University in 1989, followed by her Juris Doctor from The University of Texas at Austin School of Law in 1994. The same year, she gained her license to practice law in Texas and was recognized for her litigation skills with admission to the Order of Barristers.

During her legal studies, Ms. Bolton was an active participant in The Robert W. Calvert American Inn of Court in Austin. She was also an associate editor of the Journal of Women and the Law. Outside of her law practice, she is a committed member of the Texas Bar College and contributes to the State Bar of Texas’s Family Law Section and the Texas Family Law Foundation. Furthermore, her legal skills are recognized with a “Superb” rating on Avvo.
